name: dispatching-parallel-agents
title: dispatching-parallel-agents
description: Dispatches independent tasks to parallel agents when the work has no shared state or sequential dependencies: one agent per problem domain, self-contained prompts with constraints and expected output, then integration and a full verification pass.
why: The parallel counterpart to subagent-driven-development: SDD runs one plan task-by-task behind review gates; this fans independent problems out at once and merges the results — the missing gear for multi-front debugging and research.
